info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Events Ticketing Tickets Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Status Retrieval API provides a means to access the current status of tickets associated with various events. This endpoint allows users to query and retrieve detailed information about ticket availability, current sales status, and potential restrictions. Typical consumers include event organizers and ticketing platforms that need to manage and display ticket statuses efficiently. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their ticketing services and ensure users have up-to-date information regarding their ticket statuses.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of tickets within the system. It provides essential information regarding the state of tickets, enabling better tracking and management of ticket workflows.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to obtain the status of tickets. It provides the necessary parameters to filter and retrieve the relevant ticket status information.

200.description: The request was completed successfully, and the current status of the tickets is returned.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the status information for tickets in the operations GET request. It is formatted as a string that should contain the status details.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusResponse.title: Ticket Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the ticket status retrieval was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the ticket.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time taken to retrieve the ticket status, in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message providing context or error details.

audit.description: Audit information related to the ticket processing.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusResponse.description: Schema representing the response structure for the Ticket Status API.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the ticket.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the ticket was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the ticket processing was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit information for the ticket processing.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time in milliseconds that the server took to process the request. A value of 0 indicates that the processing was instantaneous.
